venues.name: D&C DC
venues.weather: Beautiful day out, definitely contributed to some foot traffic in the neighborhood
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Sunday 3/8.** Solid Sunday with a higher than normal cover count, mostly 2- and 4-tops. A misunderstanding about Sunday opening times was covered by Alex and Ian. Room almost full 5:30-7:30 with lots of food going out; slowed ~8; natural close at 10. Shoutout to Josh for helping. Kitchen: 18% of sales; bikini sandwiches the consistent Sunday favorite. MOD: Jamal.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Sunday 3/8.** Strong start, then streets died until sunset; early guests included a Gentian-obsessed producer with Georgian wine friends and midwesterners. Salon Sundays continues with mid-size groups from several time zones. Best back catalog: Paradise Lost (x2). 1 large party, 3 solos. Comps $78. Top sellers: Masari, Space, Material Control, Fries, Revenant. Door: slow Sunday that started with a kick; high foot traffic but people preferred outdoors; illusion of a full room around 9/10pm; died almost completely after 10:30. No no-shows. Kitchen: good work with a table that ordered 10 things. Note: some checks closed via an offline tap reader still show open, so numbers may shift slightly.
